articles.title: Indian Army upgrades 'Make in India' 96 T-72 tanks with night-fighting systems
articles.summary: The Indian Army has successfully equipped 96 T-72 tanks with indigenously manufactured Thermal Imaging Fire Control Systems (TIFCS). These domestically developed systems have passed rigorous firing validation trials, significantly enhancing the tanks' night fighting capabilities and accuracy. This upgrade boosts the operational effectiveness of the armoured fleet and reinforces India's commitment to self-reliance in defence technology.

articles.title: New Frostrail video delivers more survival train horror shooting plus weird underground Tomb Raider temples
articles.summary: Frostrail, a new first-person co-op horror survival game by Barotrauma's creators, is receiving mixed initial reactions from reviewers. Despite a general appreciation for 'apocalypse train' narratives, one reviewer expresses surprising ambivalence towards this latest title. Aspiring players might find its unique blend of co-op survival and horror elements intriguing, but initial impressions suggest a nuanced experience awaits.

articles.title: Gainers & Losers: Redington, Tejas Networks among 8 stocks in limelight on Friday
articles.summary: India's Nifty and Sensex benchmark indices closed with significant losses on Friday due to widespread selling pressure. Key sectors like Auto, financials, and FMCG experienced major declines, reflecting broad market weakness. However, the IT sector saw some selective buying, indicating a mixed performance despite the overall downturn. This market trend signifies current economic sentiments.

articles.title: Watch: This teen innovator from Gujarat has designed a life-saving device for fighter jets, DRDO takes notice
articles.summary: A 17-year-old aeronautical engineering student from Vadodara has garnered attention from India's top defence research agency. He developed a simple mechanical system designed to significantly improve and simplify fighter jet ejection mechanisms. This innovation holds potential for enhancing pilot safety and efficiency in critical situations, showcasing a promising national contribution to defence technology from a young talent.

articles.title: Emma Roberts to Star in BRIDE WARS Reimagination For TV at Peacock
articles.summary: Actress Emma Roberts, known for roles in "American Horror Story," is slated to both star in and executive produce an upcoming television series. This new project will serve as a reimagining of the 2009 romantic comedy film "Bride Wars." The development signifies a dual role for Roberts in TV production and reflects the ongoing trend of adapting popular films for new series.
